evidence.quote: Application deadline: 15 May (non EU and non EEA applicants), 31 August (EU and EEA applicants)
Please note that we do not cooperate with uni-assist and this examination is carried out exclusively by our university.

English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: Cambridge English Qualifications: B2 First TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 72 TOEIC: 785 Reading: 385 Listening: 400 Speaking: 160 Writing: 150 IELTS Academic: 5.5
Higher Education Entrance Qualification for Germany or equivalent

note.fr: Votre diplôme de fin d'études secondaires doit être reconnu comme équivalent au baccalauréat allemand (HZB). Vérifiez la procédure d'équivalence sur ANABIN et auprès de l'université.
note.en: Your school-leaving certificate must be recognized as equivalent to the German higher education entrance qualification (HZB). Check recognition via ANABIN and with the university.

evidence.quote: If you have a foreign university entrance qualification, it must be evaluated by our university as part of the application process.

notes: Tuition: DAAD page states "Tuition fees per semester None" and programme page states "Fees: None (only semester fees)", but these are general statements not tied to a non-EU applicant; the semester fee (approx. 380-394.80 EUR) is an institution-wide semester contribution, not tuition, so no tuition fee fact is given. Application period: DAAD page gives a period "1 September - 15 May" for non-EU applicants without a year; university page gives "15 May for non-EU and non-EEA applicants" without a year, so recorded as recurringDeadline. Application channel: the programme page lists "Uni-Assist Application" as the route for holders of a higher education entrance qualification from outside Germany, but the DAAD programme page explicitly says the university does not cooperate with uni-assist and the examination is carried out exclusively by the university; the university's own application route is recorded (de-university-direct). Documents: the pages name no explicit document list for this programme (no school-leaving certificate, passport or translation requirements quoted), so the documents fact is omitted.
